```{r, include = FALSE}
### Load packages
require(tidyverse)
require(leaflet)
require(crosstalk)
library(plotly)
# Idea from https://www.zajichekstats.com/post/filterable-maps/ 
```


```{r data-download, include = FALSE}
# Load Data
HAT_sites_HAT <- read.csv("data/HAT-Sites-HAT.csv", fileEncoding="UTF-8")
str(HAT_sites_HAT)
head(HAT_sites_HAT)

crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site_1 <- read.csv("data/crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site.csv", fileEncoding="UTF-8")
str(crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site_1)
head(crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site_1)
```



```{r create-sharable-database, include = FALSE}
### Create sharable database using Crosstalk package
# Make the shared data set
sd_crew <- SharedData$new(data = crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site_1)
```


```{r create-sharable-database-HAT-sites, include = FALSE}
### Create sharable database using Crosstalk package
# Make the shared data set
sd_sites <- SharedData$new(data = HAT_sites_HAT)
```


# Plots: Crew Data


```{r staff-hrs-site}

# Create a filter input
site_filter = filter_select(id = "Work_Site", label = "Choose Work Site", sharedData = sd_crew, group = ~ Work_Site, multiple = T)
year_filter = filter_select(id = "Year", label = "Choose Year", sharedData = sd_crew, group = ~ Year, multiple = T)

bscols(
  site_filter, 
  widths = 12
)
bscols(
  year_filter, 
  widths = 12
)

HAT_data_inv_site_metrics_staffhrs <- ggplot(sd_crew, 
   aes(x = Work_Site, y = Crew_Hours, fill = Work_Site)) + 
#  aes(x = Site, y = Hours)) +   
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5, position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() + #get rid of grey background and tick marks
  theme(legend.position ="right") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1, size = 7)) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colours_4) +
        labs(title='HAT Staff Site Hours',
          subtitle='invasive species removal',
          caption = "Chart by Wendy Anthony \n 2025-11-17", fill = "",          
#         caption = "Chart by Wendy Anthony \n 2025-11-17", fill = "",
          x = "Site", y = "Staff Hours")

HAT_data_inv_site_metrics_staffhrs

# ggsave(filename = paste0("images/HAT_data_inv_site_metrics_staffhrs_plot_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d_%H.%M"),".png"), HAT_data_inv_site_metrics_staffhrs)
```

```{r crew-data-2022-2025-plots-biomass-facet, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# order of elements to appear on webpage
bscols(
  widths = c(1, 11),
  "",
  htmltools::h3("HAT Managed Work Crew Invasive Species Removal", style = "font-style:italic;")
)
bscols(
    widths = c(1,11),
    "",
    htmltools::h4("Note: These filters need to be manually reset to delete unwanted choices")
)

# Create a filter input
site_filter = filter_select(id = "Work_Site", label = "Choose Work Site", sharedData = sd_crew, group = ~ Work_Site, multiple = T)
year_filter = filter_select(id = "Year", label = "Choose Year", sharedData = sd_crew, group = ~ Year, multiple = T)

bscols(
  site_filter, 
  widths = 12
)
bscols(
  year_filter, 
  widths = 12
)

ggplotly(
    ggplot(sd_crew, aes(x = Crew_Hours, y = Biomass_Removed_m3, fill = Work_Site)) + 
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 11, position = "dodge") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Year), vjust = 1.3, size = 2.5) , 
    tooltip = NULL, config = (displayModeBar = False) 
  ) %>%
    layout(legend = list(orientation="h",
    xanchor="center",
    x = 0.5,
    # gives some space between x axis label and legend
    y = -0.2
    ))
# title = list('Biomass Removed & HAT Work Crew Hours 2022-2025', font = size = 8), 
```

# Map

```{r leaflet-all-sites, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, include = FALSE}

# Title control
# (Shackelford, et al., 2024). Global Restore Project. Restoration Futures Lab at the University of Victoria
     title <- '<p style="text-align: center; height: 18px; "><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5e3c5b7e5460c55405a6d4d6/a8c2fb30-96fd-4042-925f-e76c7040dce6/Black+Logo+2.png?format=5w"><span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:bold; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9;");>GOE Monitoring Covenant Sites Map</span></p>'
     
    # https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/articles/markers.html
    # Create a palette that maps factor levels to colors
    #####
 # #d95f02 orange; #7570b3 purple; #1b9e77 
     # https://colorbrewer2.org/#type=qualitative&scheme=Dark2&n=5
    # pal <- colorFactor(c("#1b9e77", "#7570b3", "#d95f02", "#e7298a", "#66a61e"), domain = c("Central Saanich", "Colwood", "Esquimalt", "Saanich", "Metchosin"))
     pal <- colorFactor(c("#1b9e77", "#7570b3", "#e7298a"), domain = c("Central Saanich", "Esquimalt", "Colwood"))
HAT_sites_HAT_map  <-  leaflet(sd_sites) %>%
      addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        ~ Lng, ~ Lat,
        #
        color = ~pal(Municipality),
        # color = "yellow",
        weight = 1, # size of circle border
        stroke = TRUE, fillOpacity = 1, #fillOpacity = 0.5
        radius = 5,
        # OM_site_data$
        # "<b>Global Restore Project GOE Monitoring Sites</b>", "<br>", "<i>(Shackelford, et. al., 2005-2022)</i>", "<br><br>",
        popup = paste0(
        "<img src = 'https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5e3c5b7e5460c55405a6d4d6/a8c2fb30-96fd-4042-925f-e76c7040dce6/Black+Logo+2.png?format=5w'>",  "<br>","<br>",
          "<b>Site:</b> ", "<b>", HAT_sites_HAT$Site, "</b>",  "<br>",
          "<b>Municipality:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$Municipality, "<br>",
          "<b>Size:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$Size_ha, " (ha)", "<br>",
          "<b>First Nations:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$FirstNations, "<br>",
          # "<b>Project id:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$ID, "<br>",
          "<b>HAT Status:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$HAT_Status, "<br>",
          "<b>Co-Covenant:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$Co_Covenant, " (", HAT_sites_HAT$Date, ")", "<br>",
          "<b>Ecosystems:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$Ecosystems, "<br>",
          "<b>Volunteer Stewardship:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$Volunteer_Stewardship, "<br>"
          ))  %>%
      addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = HAT_sites_HAT$Municipality, title = "Municipality") %>%

      setView(-123.44799, 48.52919, 9) %>%
      # add controls
      #  addMiniMap(width = 150, height = 150, zoomLevelOffset = -4) %>%
      addControl(title, position = "topright")

# Display map
HAT_sites_HAT_map

# Save map
# saveWidget(HAT_sites_HAT_map, "output/HAT_site_HAT_map.html")
```


```{r map-filter, echo = FALSE}
# order of elements to appear on webpage
bscols(
  widths = c(1, 11),
  "",
  htmltools::h3("HAT Managed Public GOE Sites", style = "font-style:italic;")
)
# Size filter
bscols(
  widths = c(1, 10, 1),
  "",
  filter_slider(
    id = "Size_ha",
    label = "Size in ha",
    sharedData = sd_sites,
    column = ~Size_ha,
    step = 1,
    min = 0,
    max = 20,
    post = "ha"
  ),
  ""
)

bscols(
    widths = c(1,11),
    "",
    htmltools::h4("Note: These filters need to be manually reset to ALL")
)
# Cohort filters: Row 1
bscols(
  widths = c(1, 3, 3, 3, 1),
  "",
  filter_select(
    id = "Partner_Code",
    label = "Partner",
    sharedData = sd_sites,
    group = ~Partner_Code
  ),
  filter_select(
    id = "Municipality",
    label = "Municipality",
    sharedData = sd_sites,
    group = ~Municipality
  ),
  filter_select(
    id = "FirstNations",
    label = "First Nations",
    sharedData = sd_sites,
    group = ~FirstNations
  ),
  ""
)
HAT_sites_HAT_map
```
